m: 1. का onomat. imitation of the cry of the ass, BhP. x, 15, 30.
2. का = 2. कद् and 1. कु in comp. to express depreciation, e.g. काक्ष, का-पथ, कापुरुष, कोष्ण, qq.vv. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 104; Vop. vi, 93.

3. का = √ कन् (perf. चके, चकान; see कायमान s.v.), to seek, desire, yearn, love (with acc. and dat.), RV.; to like, enjoy, be satisfied with (loc. gen. or inst.), RV. : Intens. (p. चाकत्) to please, be sought after, be wished for, satisfy, RV. x, 29, 1 (cf. अनु-, आ-, सं- √ 3. का, काति.)
